question_text: Describe how you diagnose a device that cannot reach the network.
expected_answer: You check IP settings test gateway reachability and inspect cabling

question_text: Explain how you troubleshoot slow system performance.
expected_answer: You review resource usage check background processes and inspect disk health

question_text: Describe how you diagnose intermittent connectivity.
expected_answer: You test signal strength inspect cabling and monitor for drops over time

question_text: Explain how you troubleshoot an application that freezes.
expected_answer: You review logs check resource usage and restart the application

question_text: Describe how you diagnose a device that cannot print.
expected_answer: You check printer status verify drivers and test network reachability

question_text: Explain how you troubleshoot a device with no audio.
expected_answer: You check output device settings test drivers and inspect hardware

question_text: Describe how you diagnose a device that cannot access shared resources.
expected_answer: You verify permissions check network path and confirm credentials

question_text: Explain how you troubleshoot a system that reboots unexpectedly.
expected_answer: You check logs inspect hardware and test for overheating

question_text: Describe how you diagnose a device with DNS issues.
expected_answer: You test name resolution check DNS settings and verify server reachability

question_text: Explain how you troubleshoot a device that cannot authenticate.
expected_answer: You check credentials verify domain connectivity and inspect account status
